name: MatchVision
summary:
One thousand matchstick puzzles. One perfect solution each. Can you see it?

Move a single stick and a wrong equation becomes right. Take one away and four squares become three. Every puzzle looks impossible for about ten seconds, and then it doesn't.

WHAT YOU'LL SOLVE
• 1,000 hand-made puzzles, none randomly generated
• Equations: move, add or remove sticks to repair broken arithmetic
• Squares: reshape a grid to leave an exact number of squares
• Triangles: the same idea, at sharper angles
